title: Ash-Shakur: The Divine Name That Calls God Grateful
excerpt: The Quran applies the word for deep gratitude to God Himself. It appears twelve times — four naming Allah, the rest describing people — and the two groups are kept apart by what each is paired with.
seo_title: Ash-Shakur: Meaning of the Divine Name in the Quran
seo_description: Ash-Shakur names God with the word for gratitude. Of Allah it pairs with Al-Ghafur; of people it pairs with sabbar. What the divine name actually means.
